thread:
InfraBot: INCIDENT ALERT: GPU pool 'inference-west-1' at 100% utilization. autoscaler failed to add nodes (pool max reached). queue length x6, latency spike across hosted API. Pager: on-call.

Alex: I'm on it — jumping into autoscaler logs and the queue dashboard.

Maria: Seeing the same on runtime metrics. autoscaler logs show `Reached pool max nodes` and provisioning attempts timed out.

Jamal: FYI k8s events show pods Pending due to insufficient nodes, `FailedScheduling` with taints/nodes-not-ready not the issue. This is pure node quota/ceiling.

Alex: Customer impact note: 30% of generation requests are being throttled/backpressured, some 5xxs from the queue drain logic. Pooja can you surface impacted customers?

Pooja: Noted — preliminary list: acme-inc (high volume), beta-shop (trial), a handful of dev accounts. CS already flagged higher latency tickets. Will update SLA impact matrix.

Maria: Logs snippet:
```
[autoscaler] 2026-06-14T09:12:31Z scale_attempt pool=inference-west-1 desired=18 current=12 max=12 reason=PoolMaxReached
[autoscaler] 2026-06-14T09:12:31Z error: cloudprovider quota exceeded or pool max nodes reached
```

Alex: Looks like the pool max is enforced by our infra quota config (safety limit). We need a manual cap bump to let autoscaler reach desired capacity while we investigate why desired spiked. Options: 1) temporary pool max raise, 2) route low-priority traffic to cpu-only fallback, 3) throttle new jobs.

Sam: I can do a manual raise but need approval from infra owners. Propose bump max nodes from 12 -> 20 (temporary). Also can spin up a short-lived preemptible burst pool as safety.

Helen: I'm taking handoff in 5m and will coordinate approvals. On-call takeover: Helen (09:20-11:20).

Alex: Approve temporary bump to 20 for 60 minutes, then revert. Sam, proceed if you can confirm cloud quota available.

Sam: Checking cloud quotas now — compute quota spare for region looks ok for +8 GPUs but we need IAM approval to change pool limits. Sending approval request to infra-approvals.

Sam: (infra-approvals) Approve? Need explicit ACK to proceed with manual pool max change.

Maria: While waiting, start a quick routing change to protect critical customers: add rule to route `priority=high` to existing nodes and `priority=low` to queued CPU-only workers. I'll prepare the patch.

Pooja: Noted — we'll notify affected accounts that we're mitigating and expect partial restoration in ~10m.

InfraBot: APPROVAL REQUEST posted to #infra-approvals: change pool `inference-west-1` max_nodes 12->20 for 60m. Request id: INC-1768502468-A1.

Sam: Approved by infra-owner @Sam (manual approval captured). Running command now:
```
# one-off pool config update
gcloud alpha gpu-pools update inference-west-1 --max-nodes=20 --region=us-west1
```

Jamal: Confirmed autoscaler got updated desired -> provisioning can start. k8s shows new node requests.

Sam: Raised max from 12 -> 20. Cloud is provisioning nodes (preemptible preference off for now). ETA ~4m.

InfraBot: Node pool update: SUCCESS. 8 additional instances requested, provisioning in progress.

Maria: Autoscaler now scheduling new nodes, several Pending pods are moving to Running. Queue length dropping.

Alex: Rolling status: error rate for generation endpoints down from 30% -> 7% in last 6m. Latency back to acceptable for high-priority traffic.

Pooja: Notifying impacted customers: message sent to acme-inc & beta-shop, included mitigation and ETA for full recovery.

Helen: On-call handoff summary for whoever picks up next: cause = autoscaler hit enforced pool max; mitigation = manual pool max bump to 20 for 60m + routing change to protect high-priority requests. Action items: follow up to determine why desired jumped (eval job surge?), update autoscaler doc to include clearer escalation flow, and create permanent capacity increase if baseline stays high.

Sam: I'll monitor node health, if anything odd (failed provisioning, quota) I'll revert and notify.

Maria: Quick post-incident note: we should add a pre-approved escalation path for emergency cap bumps for critical pools to avoid approval latency.

Alex: Agreed. Also add a safety fallback in runtime to auto-fallback to smaller model variants when queue >X for >Y minutes.

InfraBot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: queue metrics normalized and autoscaler operating within new limits. Manual bump will auto-revert at +60m unless infra-owner extends. Incident ticket INC-1768502468 created for postmortem.

Pooja: I'll start drafting customer-facing summary and coordinate follow-up comms.

Helen: Closing notes: no data loss, no confidential exposure. Slight SLA degradation for ~12m window for some customers. Will attach metrics to the incident ticket. :thumbsup:

Alex: Thanks everyone — good coordination. Closing thread after postmortem is attached. :white_check_mark:
